title: Bayyinaango Drown
intro: Natal laamɗo baawɗo taarotooɗo teddeendi, monimaaji, e konuuli ɗooftotooɗi yamiroore wootere. Ooɗoo limoore wiyi ina jogii laamu ɓurngu toowde, ina woppi maandeeji diineeji ɗii, ina yamiri yo ɓe njokku e maayo ngo haa laaɓa cer. Rewtu laawol gila e jamirooje mawnikinaare haa e ndiyam ceertuɗam, ɗo konngol cakkitiingol ari haa ɓooyi ngam hisnude.
clues: Miɗo joginoo doole timmuɗe, miɗo maccunoo Ɓiɓɓe Isra’iila les laamu am.
Mi hollitii hoore am ko mi joom ɓurɗo toowde, mi salii jaɓde kala laamɗo ɓurɗo am.
Mi yamirii Haman yo mahno am suudu toowndu mbele mi ndaara Alla Muusaa.
Mi fotti e Muusaa e Haruna nde ɓe ngaddi maandeeji laaɓtuɗi, mi noddi kaawisaaji maɓɓe ko siiri.
Mi riiwi Muusaa e goomin6e e konuuji am jamma haa min njottii maayo.
Mi bayyini goonɗinal nde njippiimi e maayo, kono ɗum ɓooyii, ɓanndu am ina reenaa e maande.

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: Werlaama e nder yiite wonti cooyngal e kisal
Mahi laana ngam daɗde e ilam mawɗam
Ɗaani e nder ngaska e sehilaaɓe duuɓi keewɗi
Waɗii liɗɗi mawɗi e nder lugge
Njokki nde o rewi Muusaa e Isra'iila'en nder maayo fecciingo
trial.answer: Njokki nde o rewi Muusaa e Isra'iila'en nder maayo fecciingo

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Njokki e keefeere e ɓanndu reenaaɗo ko maande wonande ɓeen caggal
outcome.answer: Njokki e keefeere e ɓanndu reenaaɗo ko maande wonande ɓeen caggal

arabic: ءَآلْـَٔـٰنَ وَقَدْ عَصَيْتَ قَبْلُ وَكُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
verse: Now? And you had disobeyed [Him] before and were of the corrupters? (10:91)
